about_short_description.short_description: ProSights is an AI-native workflow automation and search platform for financial institutions.

product.name: Prism by ProSights
product.description: An enterprise automation tool for financial data extraction, chart generation, and workflow automation tailored to finance professionals.

product.name: Table Extraction
product.description: Extracts financial data from PDFs and complex images into Excel formatted to company standards.

product.name: Smart Chart Generation
product.description: Generates charts from PDFs or images into Excel-ready formats, including unlabeled charts.

product.name: API Integration
product.description: Provides API access to ProSights' table and chart extraction capabilities for integration into proprietary workflows.

product.name: Excel Add-In
product.description: An Excel plugin that automates data extraction and chart generation with full auditability in company-specific formats.

product.name: Logo Maps
product.description: Extracts company logos from lists or market maps into PNG format for PowerPoint presentations.
